bias.en: Bearish · held $94.5 after a test of $90
bias.zh: 偏空 · 测试 $90 后守住 $94.5

read.en: Intel fell 2.8% on Oct 15 to $95.37 on volume 1.4 times its 20-day average and is down 11% in five sessions. It is below its 5-day ($100.5), 10-day ($107.1), 30-day ($109.2) and falling 100-day ($107.5) averages, and above the 200-day ($84.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 5 ($113.5), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 英特尔 10月15日下跌 2.8%，收于 $95.37，成交量为 20 日均量的 1.4 倍，五个交易日下跌 11%。股价位于 5 日（$100.5）、10 日（$107.1）、30 日（$109.2）和下行的 100 日均线（$107.5）下方，并在 200 日均线（$84.3）上方。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线下方并在零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 10月5日起看空（$113.5），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The day's low of $90.02 broke the $94.5 September low intraday and nearly reached the Jul 17 low ($89.6), but the close recovered above $94.5. Resistance is $98.3 (June pivot), then $100.5 (5-day average) and $107–109 (10, 100 and 30-day averages). Support is $94.5, then $89.6–90 (Jul 17 and Oct 15 lows) and $85 (Aug 24 low). A close below $89.6 would open $85.
